title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned capability from existing Work IQ and Agent 365 controls. The roadmap facts, billing model and control references are supported; one minor clarification should acknowledge Microsoft's alternative navigation instructions for blocking agents.

claims.claim: Work IQ MCP tenant policy is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP server can be blocked at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > Tools.
Select Work IQ MCP.
Review its current availability.
To block access to the server, select Block.

claims.claim: Individual supported MCP tools are controlled at Agents > Tools > Registry > server > Tools > tool toggle > Save.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > Tools, and then select the Registry tab.
Select an MCP server from the list to open its overview pane.
Select the Tools tab. The list shows every tool the server exposes, along with its description and an Enabled or Disabled toggle.

claims.claim: A server without tool discovery cannot have individual tools managed in this view and must instead be controlled as a whole.
claims.quote: If an MCP server doesn't support tool discovery, the Tools tab shows a message that the server doesn't support tool discovery, and individual tools aren't available to manage. In this case, use Block or allow an MCP server to control the entire server instead.
